sourceValue: The official event site announces 21–23 April 2027, One Health, St. George’s University campus in Grenada, with CARPHA, the ministry and SGU as joint hosts.
The conference has advertised sponsorship and exhibition opportunities; the exhibition offer includes face-to-face delegate engagement and a coffee break in the exhibition area.
CARPHA reports preparatory discussions with SGU about conference logistics and stakeholder engagement.
Spice Island’s official accommodation inventory is 64 luxury villa-style suites; its resort page lists all-day dining with breakfast-only options available.
The resort advertises full-service wedding/event staff and catering for up to 35 guests in its wedding offer; no general conference capacity was established.
The accommodation page’s linked flyer is for the 2026 Guyana edition and must not be treated as a 2027 Grenada hotel list.
